Key Points

  • Interested in Insight Enterprises, Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • Strong second-quarter performance: Revenue rose 15% to $2.4 billion, while adjusted EBITDA increased 29% to $190 million and adjusted EPS climbed 44% to $3.86. Growth was broad-based across hardware, cloud and services, lifting total gross margin to 21.7%.

  • Raised 2026 outlook and strategic focus: Insight increased its gross-profit-growth forecast to 8%-10% and adjusted EPS guidance to $12.20-$12.70. Its three-year "One Insight Plan" targets AI infrastructure and services, operational efficiency and talent development.

  • Capital allocation favors buybacks over acquisitions: The company repurchased $75 million of shares in the quarter and plans to use the remaining $149 million authorization by year-end, while continuing to pause M&A. Management remains cautious about fourth-quarter growth due to memory-price increases, supply-chain risks and macroeconomic uncertainty.

  • Marvell Shares Gap Down: Is AI Sentiment Changing?

Insight Enterprises (NASDAQ:NSIT) reported second-quarter results that exceeded its expectations, with broad-based growth in hardware, cloud and services helping drive operating leverage. The company raised its full-year outlook for gross profit growth and adjusted diluted earnings per share while outlining a three-year "One Insight Plan" centered on AI infrastructure, AI services, operational efficiency and talent development.

For the quarter ended June 30, net revenue increased 15% year over year to $2.4 billion, or 14% on a constant-currency basis. Gross profit rose 18%, adjusted EBITDA increased 29% to $190 million, and adjusted diluted earnings per share climbed 44% to $3.86.

→ Meta's Earnings Drop Shows Wall Street Wants More Than Ad Growth

"Building on the momentum we established in the first quarter, we delivered broad-based growth across our business and generated strong operating leverage," President and CEO Jack Azagury said. He said the results reflected demand for AI-ready infrastructure, cloud modernization, cybersecurity and services designed to help clients deploy AI applications.

Hardware, Cloud and Services Contribute to Growth

Hardware revenue increased 21% during the quarter, supported by double-digit growth in both devices and infrastructure. Azagury said infrastructure hardware revenue increased by more than 20%, reflecting demand for servers, storage and networking as customers modernize technology environments and prepare for AI workloads.

市场节奏

2026 年 8 月 7 日星期五上午 12:04 MDT 阅读时间 7 分钟

要点

  • 对 Insight Enterprises, Inc. 感兴趣？ 这是我们更喜欢的五只股票。
  • 第二季度业绩强劲：收入增长 15%，达到 24 亿美元，调整后 EBITDA 增长 29%，达到 1.9 亿美元，调整后每股收益增长 44%，达到 3.86 美元。 硬件、云和服务领域均实现广泛增长，将总毛利率提升至 21.7%。
  • 上调2026年展望和战略重点：Insight将毛利润增长预测上调至8%-10%，并将每股收益指导调整至12.20-12.70美元。 其为期三年的“One Insight计划”目标是人工智能基础设施和服务、运营效率和人才发展。
  • 资本配置偏向于回购而非收购：该公司在本季度回购了 7500 万美元的股票，并计划在年底前使用剩余的 1.49 亿美元授权，同时继续暂停并购。 由于内存价格上涨、供应链风险和宏观经济不确定性，管理层对第四季度的增长仍持谨慎态度。
  • Marvell 股价下跌：人工智能情绪正在改变吗？

Insight Enterprises（纳斯达克股票代码：NSIT）公布的第二季度业绩超出了预期，硬件、云和服务的广泛增长有助于提高运营杠杆。 该公司上调了全年毛利润增长预期，调整了稀释每股收益，同时制定了围绕人工智能基础设施、人工智能服务、运营效率和人才发展的三年“One Insight计划”。

截至 6 月 30 日的季度，净收入同比增长 15%，达到 24 亿美元，按固定汇率计算增长 14%。 毛利润增长 18%，调整后 EBITDA 增长 29%，达到 1.9 亿美元，调整后摊薄每股收益增长 44%，达到 3.86 美元。

→ Meta 的盈利下降表明华尔街想要的不仅仅是广告增长

总裁兼首席执行官杰克·阿扎古里 (Jack Azagury) 表示：“在我们第一季度建立的势头的基础上，我们的业务实现了广泛的增长，并产生了强大的运营杠杆。” 他表示，结果反映了对人工智能就绪基础设施、云现代化、网络安全和旨在帮助客户部署人工智能应用程序的服务的需求。

硬件、云和服务促进增长

在设备和基础设施两位数增长的支持下，本季度硬件收入增长了 21%。 Azagury 表示，基础设施硬件收入增长了 20% 以上，反映出随着客户实现技术环境现代化并为人工智能工作负载做好准备，对服务器、存储和网络的需求。
